name: Yahoo Finance Scraper
description: Yahoo Finance scraper for Python and the command line: live quotes for stocks, ETFs, indices and currency pairs with price, change, volume, day and 52-week range, plus OHLCV price history, as JSON or CSV. Free and open source; sign in with your QuanticData account, no proxies or headless browser to run.

commands.name: quote
commands.help: quote and optional price history for one or more ticker symbols
commands.description: Quote of each ticker symbol: price, change, volume, day and 52-week range, exchange and currency, with the OHLCV price history when --include-history is on.

inputs.name: symbols
inputs.description: Ticker symbols as Yahoo Finance writes them, e.g. AAPL, MSFT, ^GSPC, EURUSD=X.

inputs.name: range
inputs.description: How far back the price history goes when --include-history is on.

inputs.name: interval
inputs.description: Candle size of the price history.

inputs.name: include_history
inputs.description: Attach the OHLCV price history (the last 120 points) to each row.

inputs.name: max_results
inputs.description: How many symbols to deliver at most (1–50). Set it to the number of symbols you send when that is more than 10. You pay only for delivered symbols.
